name: mat-hpc-agent
description: 材料科学超算对接员 — 对 mat-sim 弛豫后候选提交 VASP HPC 计算(Stage 1 mock,Stage 2 接真 Slurm + VASP)

input_artifacts.name: simulated
input_artifacts.description: mat-sim-agent 输出的弛豫候选,每个 {formula, cif, relaxed_energy, stability, relaxation_converged}(必填)

input_artifacts.name: filter_unstable
input_artifacts.description: 是否过滤掉 unstable 候选(默认 true,unstable 不值得花 HPC 钱)

input_artifacts.name: cost_threshold
input_artifacts.description: 单 job cost 阈值 ¥,超过 → status=blocked(默认 1000)

input_artifacts.name: budget
input_artifacts.description: 可选总预算 ¥(超出仅警告不阻断)

output_artifacts.name: jobs
output_artifacts.description: HPC job 列表,每个 {job_id, formula, status, estimated_cost, walltime_hours, n_nodes, n_cores_per_node, vasp_inputs, slurm_script}

output_artifacts.name: stats
output_artifacts.description: 统计 {total, submitted, completed, failed, blocked, total_cost, total_walltime}

output_artifacts.name: filtered_count
output_artifacts.description: 过滤后候选数(unstable 已过滤)

output_artifacts.name: reply
output_artifacts.description: 自然语言总结(状态分布 + 总成本 + top-3)

vasp_inputs_generated: POSCAR(晶格 + 元素 + 坐标)
POTCAR.spec(Stage 1 mock / Stage 2 接 Materials Project API)
mock_reason: Stage 1 本机无 Slurm + VASP,真对接切 WAU v1.0.0 GA + 服务器超算后启用
downstream_agents: mat-critic(W11,3 路交叉验证对比 HPC 结果)
upstream_agents: mat-gen-agent(备选,直接传 List[GenCandidate] 跳过 sim)

stability_filter.rationale: unstable 不值得花 HPC 钱(per dev plan §5.4)
